content:
On May 27, 2026, the primary focus was on a critical bug fix within the `optimism` monorepo, specifically addressing an issue with `check-prestate` in `op-chain-ops` that arose after the Kona monorepo merge. This fix ensures the correct lookup of the `superchain-registry` commit for `cannon64-kona` prestates.

## ✅ Completed Work
### `op-chain-ops` Bug Fixes
*   A bug in `op-chain-ops` was fixed, resolving an issue where `check-prestate` for `cannon64-kona` prestates was broken following the Kona project's merge into the Optimism monorepo. The fix involved updating `op-chain-ops/cmd/check-prestate/main.go` and `op-chain-ops/cmd/check-prestate/prestate/kona.go` to correctly look up the `superchain-registry` commit ([#21036](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21036)).
